content.user_title: Plan Waterproofing and Avoid Renovation Mistakes
content.value_statement: Waterproofing errors can cause leaks, mold, expensive repairs, and disputes. This skill provides practical planning, material, troubleshooting, and inspection guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains waterproofing choices for bathrooms, kitchens, balconies, roofs, exterior walls, and basements.
Compares coatings and membranes for different spaces and movement conditions.
Creates checklists for substrate preparation, detail treatment, application, flood testing, and acceptance.
Suggests diagnostic steps for leaks, damp walls, pipe penetrations, cracks, and thresholds.
Highlights contractor, quotation, sequencing, and responsibility risks during renovation.
limitations: It cannot inspect hidden damage, test materials, or confirm the source of a leak remotely.
Some recommendations reflect Chinese residential practices and may not match local building codes.
Product suitability depends on substrate, climate, manufacturer instructions, and installer experience.
Structural, electrical, legal, or severe mold concerns require qualified local professionals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Bathroom Renovation
use_cases.description: Build a waterproofing scope, contractor question list, and flood-test checklist before work starts.

use_cases.title: Review Work Before Tiling
use_cases.description: Check surfaces, corners, pipe penetrations, coating coverage, drying, and test records before approving tile installation.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Persistent Leak
use_cases.description: Organize symptoms and narrow likely sources before requesting targeted inspection or repair.
use_cases.target_user: Residents and property managers handling water damage

prompt_templates.title: Basic Room Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a waterproofing checklist for my [room]. The project is at [stage]. Explain the main risks and acceptance checks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Material Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [material A] and [material B] for my [space], [substrate], and [climate]. Cover suitability, preparation, application, and failure risks.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Leak
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me investigate this leak: [symptoms]. Ask necessary questions, rank likely causes, and propose non-destructive checks before repair.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complete Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this waterproofing plan: [plan]. Check scope, details, sequencing, testing, responsibilities, and local-code questions. Separate evidence, assumptions, and professional checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a contractor proposal

output_examples.input: My bathroom coating is finished. What should I check before tiling?
output: Confirm the substrate and coating are fully dry.
Inspect corners, pipe penetrations, drains, thresholds, and missed areas.
Run the specified flood test and inspect the room below.
Record results before approving tile work.

output_examples.input: The wall outside my shower is damp, but the floor below is dry.
output_examples.output: Likely causes include wall-side moisture, pipe leakage, failed joints, or condensation. Check timing, meter readings, fixtures, and adjacent surfaces before opening finishes.

output_examples.input: Should I waterproof a kitchen without a floor drain?
output_examples.output: Assess drainage and containment first. Waterproofing alone cannot control escaping water, so confirm local requirements and plan shutoff, pipe quality, and leak detection.

best_practices: Provide the room, substrate, climate, construction stage, symptoms, and available photos or test results.
Confirm recommendations against local codes, product instructions, and written contractor responsibilities.
Document concealed work and test results before covering the waterproofing system.
anti_patterns: Do not select a system only by brand, price, color, or claimed coat count.
Do not cover waterproofing before required drying, inspection, and flood testing are complete.
Do not repair visible stains without identifying plumbing, envelope, condensation, and drainage causes.

faq.question: Can this skill identify the exact source of a leak?
faq.answer: It can organize likely causes and checks. An exact diagnosis may require moisture testing, pressure testing, opening finishes, or professional inspection.

faq.question: Does it recommend specific waterproofing products?
faq.answer: It compares material types and selection factors. Verify each product against the substrate, climate, application, certification, and manufacturer instructions.

faq.question: Can I use the advice outside China?
faq.answer: Yes, as general planning guidance. Local codes, approved systems, climate conditions, and trade practices take priority.

faq.question: Does it replace a contractor or building inspector?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and review but cannot inspect concealed work, verify workmanship, or approve code compliance.

faq.question: What information improves the answer?
faq.answer: Share the room, construction stage, substrate, drainage, climate, leak timing, nearby plumbing, previous repairs, and test results.

faq.question: Can it review a contractor quotation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can flag missing scope, unclear quantities, weak testing terms, sequencing gaps, and responsibility issues.
